description: Pulses its output for one pass every period while enabled. Never bursts after a slow pass.

activation.text: Runs every pass while enabled. The first tick is on the pass the block becomes enabled, then every period; disabling stops it and enabling again restarts the phase.

eno.description: A one-pass pulse every period. Put it on another block's enable to run that block every period.

fields.description: Time between pulses, in the chosen time unit. A wired period wins over the one in the body; a period of 0 from the wire pauses the ticking.

hints.text: The pass (about 10 ms) is the resolution: a shorter period drops a tick on every pass
